title: Stellarium Session Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Observatory environment (`observatory:env`), sky-quality meter (`skyquality:reading`), imaging sessions (`imaging:session`), telescope mount (`mount:status`), cloud sensor (`allsky:cloud`).
app: Backyard observatory automation — roll-off-roof/dome controller, sky-quality meter, cloud sensor, telescope mount, and astrophotography software (N.I.N.A./Ekos) — via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=stellarium:session
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by target_name
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>24
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when Stellarium session data has stopped arriving for a given target.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per target and alert when the feed is older than 24 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It rates when one part of your Stellarium session feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
